quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and get ready to stop.
Stop completely, then go only if it is safe.
Go slowly through the intersection. You may not need to stop.
Stop only if traffic is coming from the intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go only if it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop. Only go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that an intersection is ahead. A road will join from the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A low railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not go through if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which direction they must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign is yellow with black markings. It tells drivers that a winding road is ahead and they should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp left turn is ahead.

questions.explanation: A sign with a red circle and slash means that action is prohibited. U-turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if emergency vehicles are near.
Look both ways before crossing the intersection.
Always stop completely at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you see a yield sign. Get ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.
The road ahead curves left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to road conditions and hazards ahead. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you to be careful when the road is wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Riders can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it means the rider will slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to road conditions and hazards ahead. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: At a yield sign, what should you do?

options.text: Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that when turning left at a green light, they must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in that direction.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains cross first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains cross first.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Always slow down when you see this sign. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Enter slowly and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road you are on will end ahead.
You must turn right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a sharp right turn is ahead.

questions.question: What is this sign warning you about?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way traffic only.
Slow down because the road ahead has a sharp curve.
A crossroad is to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead has a sharp curve.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a sharp curve. You should slow down before reaching a curve like you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits only.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
This lane is for buses and carpools.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits only.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disability permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway changes to the right.
Hiking trails are to the right.
A hotel is to the right.
A hospital is to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A hospital is to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Be careful where pedestrians may cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns that you are approaching a divided highway.

questions.question: What type of sign has this shape and color?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped warning signs are used only to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
Come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection. Be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians cross safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is reserved only for left-turning vehicles from either direction. You cannot use it to pass other vehicles or to drive straight.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and traffic.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must stop completely. Check for pedestrians and other traffic in the intersection. Do not go until the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Be prepared for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare drivers for hazards ahead. This sign warns of a sharp turn coming. You should reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it toward their side, riders behind should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Slow down and get ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange. They warn you of dangerous conditions in work areas. This sign tells you that road work is ahead. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. This lane is only for buses and cars with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: When you see this sign, it means:

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show sharp curves. The arrow points in the direction of the curve. You may see several of these signs through a curve.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign (in this case, 35 mph).

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. If you see this sign, turn around and find another way.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. In wet conditions, slow down. Avoid sudden braking or turning. Keep more distance between your vehicle and the one ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead is divided into two separate directions. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Red is always on top and green on the bottom on vertical signals. On horizontal signals, red is on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the intersection ahead and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: When a driver's left arm is extended straight out to the left, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are used instead of or with turn signals. A left arm extended straight out means the driver plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride near traffic. Drive carefully in this area because cyclists are likely present.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is coming. The road will split into two one-way directions with a divider between them. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds. This sign warns you that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show your intentions without turn signals. A left arm bent at the elbow and pointing up means the driver plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic light. It tells drivers turning left that they do not have the right-of-way and must wait for oncoming traffic to pass first.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: Make room for traffic entering from other roads. If you have multiple lanes and the one next to you is empty, move over to let entering vehicles merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. In this case, right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an overpass is ahead with limited height. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the hill.
Trucks are on the hill ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a traffic light at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that deer may cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it rains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roadways separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show rules you must obey. This sign means right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Drivers and riders can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is extended straight out to the left, it means you plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community group is picking up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that workers may be on or very close to the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow and black sign warns drivers that they are approaching a school zone. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: From bottom to top, what is the order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: From bottom to top, traffic light colors are green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A highway entrance ramp is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane ends ahead.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: You may pass if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road.
You may pass only at night.

questions.explanation: This sign is a regulatory sign. Drivers must obey it. You cannot pass other vehicles where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn you about hazards or special situations ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a complete stop and go when it is safe.
Go through the intersection slowly. You do not always have to stop.
Stop only if traffic is on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let vehicles and pedestrians in or near the intersection pass first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm with one finger pointing up?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. When the lead rider raises their left arm with one finger pointing up, it tells the group to move into a single-file line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will be entering from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is a regulation sign that tells you what to do. It means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You can go if the road is clear.
You must come to a complete stop before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. You could have a head-on crash. Carefully turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This warning sign is yellow and black. It tells you that a lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign is yellow and black. It warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid damaging your brakes or having a crash.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you to keep to the right side. This helps you avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards. This sign tells you that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Yield to other traffic. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, hand signals help riders communicate. When the leader holds their left arm out to the side with palm up, then swings it upward, it means go faster.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may turn right or go straight.
You may turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you can either turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, hand signals help riders communicate. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards. This sign tells you that traffic is coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming. Look for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at this exact speed.
The highest legal speed here is 55 mph.
You must drive 55 mph through intersections.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed here is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest speed you can legally drive. In bad weather or poor conditions, you should drive slower than this limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a traffic light is coming. Be ready to stop for a red light or slow down for a yellow light.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Stop every time, even if there's no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always watch for people crossing the street, especially at crosswalks. Be ready to stop if needed.

questions.question: This sign shows a type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a road crosses ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a steep hill is ahead. Slow down and be ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you the road ahead makes a sharp right turn and then a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns drivers of low clearance ahead.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: The speed limit is the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit depending on conditions. When conditions are poor, always drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what should you do?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will exit the freeway. You can change lanes to continue on the freeway, or you must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals to show turns or stops instead of turn signals. A left arm bent at the elbow and pointing upward means the rider will turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe exit speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that drivers must obey. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that the right lane will end. Traffic in the right lane must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the divided highway will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing at ground level. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get caught on the tracks at this crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there are three or more curves ahead on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow backgrounds. This sign warns drivers that the road may be slippery when wet, making vehicles harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean when riding in a group?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are used for group communication. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, all riders should stop.

questions.question: What is the main concern when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may be misaligned because one side of your vehicle is higher than the other.
You may damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You may hydroplane if there is water on the shoulder.
You may lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If a wheel drops onto the shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
Only one car at a time can use the bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
